events.subtitle: FEELS LIVE — Feels in full

priority_review.rationale: Scarcity challenge: the fact that Feels is a celebrated album is not enough for S. The event-specific scarcity is that Animal Collective says its members' schedules had not lined up, that only a short window opened, and that it will play just two FEELS LIVE shows—Queens on October 22 and Los Angeles on October 24—marking the first time the full band has played together in four years. Would A+ still capture the recommendation? No: for the US corridor, Queens is the only East Coast opportunity to hear the reunited group rebuild Feels in sequence with recovered period loops, tunings, pedals, and MiniDisc sounds, plus extras from that era. Missing that exact short-window encounter would create genuine regret. S is warranted; S+ is not, because a second performance exists in Los Angeles, no farewell or final performance is announced, and the band leaves open what may happen later.

events.factual_description: Animal Collective will perform FEELS LIVE at Knockdown Center in Queens, New York on Thursday, October 22, 2026. AXS lists doors at 7:00 PM, showtime at 8:00 PM, an 18+ age restriction, and general on-sale beginning Friday, September 11 at 10:00 AM local time. Domino's September 8 announcement states that the band will play its 2005 album Feels in full plus extras from the same period, and that the Queens show and an October 24 Fonda Theatre show in Los Angeles are the only two announced FEELS LIVE performances. Domino says these concerts mark the first time Animal Collective has played together in four years and quotes the band describing a short scheduling window and the process of recovering old loops, tunings, pedals, and a working MiniDisc player for the performances. A separate Domino live-calendar entry currently labels a September 15 Sid The Cat Auditorium date as Animal Collective, but KCRW's exact event page identifies that September 15 performance as Croz Boyce, the duo of Animal Collective members Dave Portner (Avey Tare) and Brian Weitz (Geologist); it is therefore not treated as a contradictory full-band performance.

en.why_it_matters: This is not just an anniversary-album play. Animal Collective is using a rare window when the full group can be together to rebuild Feels from its old loops, tunings, pedals, and MiniDisc-era textures, then add material from the same period. That makes the Queens night a live reconstruction of a particular experimental language—and the band's first shared stage in four years—rather than a routine catalog tour.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, I would protect October 22 and make the New York trip if this branch of experimental rock matters to the listening thread. Queens is the only East Coast date in a two-show window, so there is no nearby fallback; the Los Angeles performance two days later is the only announced alternative.

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es simplemente tocar un disco de aniversario. Animal Collective está aprovechando una ventana poco común en la que el grupo completo puede coincidir para reconstruir Feels desde sus loops, afinaciones, pedales y texturas de MiniDisc de aquella época, y después sumar material del mismo periodo. La noche de Queens funciona así como la reconstrucción en vivo de un lenguaje experimental muy específico —y como el primer escenario compartido de la banda en cuatro años—, no como una gira rutinaria de catálogo.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV protegería el 22 de octubre y haría el viaje a Nueva York si este hilo del rock experimental pesa en la escucha. Queens es la única fecha de la Costa Este dentro de una ventana de sólo dos conciertos, así que no hay un reemplazo cercano; la única alternativa anunciada es Los Ángeles dos días después.
